Commentary.Commentary: That's your lot for the day. The third ODI is on 13th July 2021 at Edgbaston. The action will begin at 1 pm local (12 pm GMT) but you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers from our side.

Got to feel bad for Hasan Ali. He had an outstanding match, both with the ball and bat. His fifer broke the back of England's batting and when the chips were down, his attacking batting sent shivers in the English camp. Despite all his heroics, he had to end on the losing side this evening and that's very unfortunate. Anyway, it's part and parcel of the game.

Lewis Gregory, the MAN OF THE MATCH, says that it was the case of taking it as deep as possible and bat a few overs. Tells that the ball nibbled a bit all day and he felt that they could pitch it up and get some wickets. Feels that the guys were outstanding. Mentions that it is a fantastic opportunity for the lads to show what they are capable of.

Ben Stokes, the England skipper, is thrilled with the way they showed intent with the bat early on. Mentions that it was a tricky middle period for them with the bat but also adds that it was pleasing to see the inexperienced players showing the attacking mindset. Calls England's performance with the ball clinical and tells that picking early wickets always helps while defending scores. States that Gregory and Carse are capable batsmen and their partnership gave England a good total. Says that they have won the series but there is nothing like continuing the winning streak and promises to come even harder in the next match.

Babar Azam, the Pakistan skipper, says that they bowled well in the first 10 overs but they needed to maintain the same intensity. Adds that Hasan Ali bowled outstandingly well. Tells that they did not utilize the first 10 overs with the bat and did not get any big partnerships either and they need to rectify that in the next game. Goes onto say that Hasan Ali was brilliant and Saud Shakeel showed his passion and he performed well. Adds that they will try their best to win the last match as crucial World Cup Super League points are at stake.
Time for the presentation...

After a stuttering batting show by the English batsmen, it was necessary for their bowlers to put the best foot forward. Saqib Mahmood and Lewis Gregory were once again brilliant with the new balls as they maintained a tight grip on the scoring rate along with giving Pakistan the initial blows. The second line of the English bowling attack comprising Craig Overton, Brydon Carse and Matt Parkinson was quite impressive as well. Altogether, it was a complete team effort although the victory didn't come as easy as it came in Cardiff.

Chasing a target of 248, all Pakistan needed was a steady start. But their top order flopped again. Fakhar, Babar and Rizwan, the in-form batsmen for them, had yet another forgetful outing with the bat. The Pakistan skipper did play a few delightful shots before getting out but Zaman struggled big-time during his stay. In the first 10 overs, three wickets were down and the touring team was always behind the 8-ball from thereon. Saud Shakeel was the only batsman who showed the composure and desire to stay out in the middle and build an inning. He notched up his maiden ODI fifty and kept a little bit of hope alive for Pakistan. There were a couple of moments when Pakistan managed to scare England. One was when Hasan Ali took Matt Parkinson to the cleaners and another was when the stand between Saud and Shaheen Afridi was blossoming. It was taking Pakistan slowly but steadily towards the target. One thing is for sure, had Pakistan been more sensible in preserving their wickets, they would have ended on the right side of the result. This is something for the team management to ponder on.

It was not a perfect game by any means for England as they had their fair share of struggle, mainly with the bat. After starting on the wrong note, Salt and Vince steadied the innings with their attacking partnership. Just when it appeared that the hosts will run away with a big score on the board, Pakistan bounced back via their spinners. Shakeel and Shadab combined to remove both the set batsmen and then the Three Lions suffered a collapse. They lost 5 wickets in the blink of an eye and were staring down the barrel. Then, came an unlikely alliance between Gregory and Carse. The pair added 69 runs for the 8th wicket and helped England recover from a precarious situation.
Victory for England and they have taken an unassailable lead in the series along with strengthening their position at the top in the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Super League.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! That's it! Brilliant stuff! Short and down the leg side, Rauf looks to pull but it goes off the gloves to the left of John Simpson. The English wicketkeeper dives across and takes a very good catch. They appeal and the finger has gone up. ENGLAND WIN BY 52 RUNS AND WIN THE SERIES WITH ONE GAME TO SPARE.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Lewis Gregory

Commentary.Commentary: SWING AND A MISS! Full one outside off, Rauf looks to swing it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length ball on off, Rauf defends it to point.
Short ball on middle, Afridi pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
On a length on middle, Rauf nudges it to the leg side for one.
Full on off, Afridi punches it to deep cover for one.
Haris Rauf is the last man in. Lewis Gregory is back into the attack as well.

OUT! End of Saud Shakeel and it's the final nail in the coffin of Pakistan. Matt Parkinson once again gives it a good toss and tempts the batsman. It lands full around middle and Saud kneels to smoke it over mid-wicket and into the stands. But to his bad luck, his shot doesn't have enough distance and it falls straight down the throat of Craig Overton near the fence. A dejected Shakeel walks back but he has shown to his teammate that it was doable.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Overton b Matt Parkinson

Commentary.Commentary: Floated one, full and on off, Shakeel slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and it falls in on man's land in the deep. They take two.
A googly this time, around off and spinning away, Shakeel tries to play the late cut but misses.
On the pads, it's tucked to mid-wicket for another run.
Uppish but safe! Shakeel dances down the track for a big shot but drags it off the inner half. It goes aerially but wide of the diving keeper for a run at long on.
Fuller in length and on middle, Shaheen sweeps it firmly through mid-wicket for a single.
That's a beauty from Overton! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but misses.
Good length ball on the pads, Afridi looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Full on off, Saud pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Full on middle, Afridi flicks it to mid-wicket and crosses for a run after hesitating for a fraction of a second. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end as Shaheen dives.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for one.

FOUR! Fifty for Saud Shakeel! First one in ODIs and he needs to stay out there if Pakistan have to win. Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to cut but gets an outside edge and it goes to third man for a boundary.
Powerplay 3 time! 5 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the game.
Another flick shot and once again Shaheen finds the fielder at mid-wicket. 70 needed off 54 balls.
Full and on middle, flicked on the leg side but to mid-wicket.
Flatter googly outside off, Shaheen guides it late to short third man.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up delivery again, on middle, Afridi winds up for a big slog sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It lobs in the air but drops safely near the pitch.
Loopy delivery, full and on middle, Shakeel gets forward and tickles it behind square leg for a run.
A nicely tossed up ball outside off, Shaheen drives it down to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Shortish outside off, Shakeel punches it through the cover region for a boundary. 71 needed in 10 overs.
On off, kept out.
Fullish ball on off, defended out.
Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full on middle, Shakeel clips it over mid-wicket for a couple. 75 needed in 64 balls.
Good length ball on middle, Shakeel pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker one, short and on off, Shaheen punches it to covers.
Short in length and outside off, Afridi gets back and slaps it to point. The fielder makes a half-stop and the batsmen get another couple.
Presses forward and pushes a full ball back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery outside off, Shaheen is forward as he pushes it defensively to point.
Tossed up ball on middle, fuller in length, Shaheen leans forward, rotates his wrists and works it down to fine leg for two.
Full and floated on off, Shakeel gets forward and pushes it gently at covers for a single.
Matt Parkinson is back into the attack. 5-0-30-1 are his figures of which he conceded 22 in one over. He was forced out of the attack by Hasan Ali.
Short ball around off, Shaheen sways away from it.
Full on off, Shaheen pushes it to cover. Shakeel is backing up too far. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! A top order batsman will be proud of this shot! Full outside off, Afridi drives it through the extra cover region for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Afridi tucks it to the leg side.
Full on off, Shakeel pushes it to deep cover for one.
Full on off, Afridi defends it to cover for a run.
Craig Overton is back on.
A leg gully comes in suggesting that Mahmood will bowl a rib tickler. It's short but outside off, Afridi dabs it towards third man and picks up a run.
The follow-up delivery is a bouncer, Afridi anticipates it well and sways away from the line by leaning back.
Beauty to beat the bat! Saqib delivers it on a length around off and gets it to straighten off the seam. Afridi is squared up in defense as it whizzes past his bat. Good take by Simpson.
Taps a length ball towards covers and picks up a single.
Good length delivery on off, Shakeel shows gentle hands as he turns it on the leg side. But he finds mid-wicket.
Mahmood angles in a length ball on off from wide of the crease, Saud shows a straight bat in defense.
On the pads, Shakeel flicks it to square leg and will keep the strike for the next over with a single.
Good length ball outside off, Afridi guides it to third man for one.
Full on middle, Afridi pushes it to mid on.
Short ball on middle, Shakeel pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on off, Shakeel pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Around off on a back of a length, Afridi defends it to the leg side. Smiles exchanged between the bowler and batsman.
England have taken a review for caught behind! There is nothing on Ultra Edge and England lose a review.

SHAHEEN IS SAFE! The number 10 runs out of patience after leaving the last two balls. Shortish ball outside off, Afridi tries to force it off his back foot but fails to make any connection. Is there some noise? England seem interested and go for the DRS. The Ultra Edge shows a flat line. Waste of a review but that doesn't matter too much at this stage.
Back of a length delivery outside off, once again Afridi holds himself back and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length delivery in the region outside off, holding its line, Afridi decides to let it go.
Short in length and outside off, Saud stands across the stumps and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Afridi stays back and taps it down behind square leg for a single.
Saqib Mahmood is back on. 2/17 in his 6 overs so far.
On off, punched to cover-point.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Saud looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Shaheen Afridi's turn to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AT FINE LEG! Carse has a wicket and it's the end of an entertaining knock from Hasan Ali. Till he was there, Pakistan had a chance and now England can take a sigh of relief. Short of a length around off, Hasan looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards fine leg. Craig Overton comes forward and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Overton b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: EDGED BUT SAFE! Full on middle, Hasan Ali looks to swing but mistimes it. Luckily for him, it lands over the mid on fielder and the batters pick a couple.
Swing and a miss! Slower one outside off, Hasan Ali clears his front leg and has a swing at it but fails to get any bat on it.
On a length outside off, Shakeel punches it to point where the fielder fumbles, allowing the batters to take a single.
WIDE! Full ball down the leg side, Shakeel looks to flick but misses. Simpson does well to dive to his right and make the stop.
Good length ball outside off, Saud Shakeel looks to cut but misses.

Drinks! The last over has brought this chase back to life somewhat! Pakistan appeared down and out but Hasan Ali's onslaught in the 30th over has given them a semblance of hope. He is already moved to 29 off 14 balls and if he stays out there any longer, Pakistan will start to fancy their chances. England are still on top but they would want to dismiss Hasan Ali as soon as possible.
Flatter and shorter on middle, quicker through the air, Ali goes back and cuts but finds the fielder at cover-point. 22 from the over!

SIX! Make it a hat-trick of sixes! The required rate has fallen under 6 now. Full and flighted around off, Hasan once again gives it the full whack of his bat and plunders it over cow corner. Exactly 100 needed now.
SIX! And again! The crowd is loving it. Tossed up ball around off, Hasan goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it handsomely over mid-wicket. Into the crowd again. Sanitize the ball, please.

SIX! Even better! Lovely flourish of the bat. Too full in length and close to off, Hasan bends his back leg and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum. 30 minutes of Hasan's batting and this chase will come back to life.
FOUR! Fuller in length, floated and on off, Hasan clears his front leg and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Flighted and full outside off, Hasan kneels down for the slog sweep but fails to connect. They appeal for a caught behind but not given.
Good length ball on middle, Ali drags it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fullish ball on off, Saud pushes it to mid off for one.
PERISCOPE! Short delivery, around off, Hasan looks to duck but keeps his bat hanging like a periscope. It takes the toe and goes down to third man for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Ali looks to swing it away but misses.
FOUR! Just over Simpson! Short ball around middle, Ali looks to pull but it goes off the gloves. Simpson hops and tries to catch but it goes over him and into the fence.
Short ball around middle, Hasan Ali ducks under it.
Brydin Carse is back on.

NOT OUT! Brilliant bowling by Parkinson. He dishes out a googly around off and gets it to spin away from the forward defensive prod of Shakeel. It beats the outside edge and Simpson is quick to dislodge the bails. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the outside edge which is absent and then goes on to check for the stumping. The replays show that Shakeel's back leg is inside the line.
An appeal for stumping taken upstairs. Simpson looks confident. Saud Shakeel is just in. Not out will be the signal.

Shout for an lbw! The impact is outside off. Tossed up ball around off, Shakeel presses forward and across to work it across but misses. He is struck on the pads but the impact is outside off. The umpire turns down the appeal.
Fullish and on off, forced down to long off for a run.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Fuller in length and on off, Hasan defends it off his front foot.
Hasan Ali makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! WHAT A GREAT REFLEX CATCH BY SIMPSON! Good anticipation shown by the English keeper and his little piece of brilliance has given England the seventh wicket. A floated leg spinner, landing full around leg, Faheem goes down and across to play the paddle sweep. Simpson senses that and moves across to his right swiftly. It takes the edge of Ashraf's bat and lobs behind where Simpson is ready to catch it with his big gloves. Pakistan are nearing a series defeat now.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Matt Parkinson

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball on middle, Ashraf pulls it uppishly but it falls hsort of the fielder at deep square leg. He was placed there just for this shot. A single taken.
Good length ball on middle, solidly defended back to the bowler.
Short of a length ball on off, Ashraf punches it back to the bowler.
Full on off, Saud pushes it wide of mid off for one.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower delivery down the leg side, Shakeel shuffles across and then looks to flick but misses. Wide not given.
A googly, landing full around off, Faheem tries to drive but is beaten all ends up.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends.
A top spinner on off, staying low, Faheem moves back and defends it from the bottom half of his bat.
Fullish and on middle, once again it's flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full around leg, Ashraf flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Brilliant fielding but only a half-stop. Full and floated on middle, Saud flicks it firmly to mid-wicket where the fielder dives and palms it behind to mid off. The batsmen
Faheem Ashraf arrives in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder at third man! England are all smiles at the moment! Another partnership was building but the hosts have managed to break it before it could become dangerous. Gregory bowls a short one outside off, Shadab Khan hops and looks to play the upper cut but doesn't time it too well. It has not got the distance and it goes towards third man where Matt Parkinson manages to hold on to the catch as it nearly popped out. 133 needed in 132 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Matt Parkinson b Lewis Gregory

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball on off, pulled wide of mid on for another single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Khan works it to deep square leg for one.

EDGED AND FOUR! Just wide of the first slip fielder! Full ball outside off, Shadab Khan looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards the vacant second slip region, Zak Crawley dives from first slip but it goes wide of him and into the third man fence.
Excellent running! Full on off, Saud pushes it to mid off and takes off for a single. Makes it comfortably.
Short ball on off, Shakeel pulls it to short mid-wicket but not in the gap.
This time Shakeel hits it straighter and caresses a full ball down to long on for a run. Tidy stuff from the leggie.
Turning back in from around off, Saud moves back and works it on the leg side, finds mid-wicket again.
Fuller and flighted on off, Shakeel draws forward and defends it back to the bowler off the toe end of his bat.
Tossed up ball landing full around off, Shakeel flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
The bowler goes short and delivers it on off, Shadab gets back and slaps it with the spin to deep cover for a run.
Flighted and full on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Short ball on middle, Khan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Shakeel looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point. Another single.
Length ball around off, an off cutter, Shadab looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards first slip. The fielder makes a half stop and a single is taken.
On a length around middle, Khan works it to mid-wicket.
Full on middle, Shakeel shuffles across and then flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Good length ball outside off, Shadab cuts it to backward point for a single.
Lewis Gregory is back into the attack. 4-0-27-1 are his figures so far.
Flatter leg spinner around off, Shadab camps back and forces it through covers for a single. 4 from Parkinson's first over!
Matt Parkinson gets away with a bad delivery. Short and outside off, Shadab cuts but finds the point fielder.
Again the length is on the shorter side, Saud goes back and strokes it to sweeper cover for a run. 100 UP FOR PAKISTAN. Another 148 needed from 152 balls.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Shadab goes deep inside the crease and punches it down to long off for a single.
Loopy and around middle, turning away a bit, Shadab presses forward and defends it to covers.
Flighted and full around off, Shakeel gets forward and works it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Time for some leg spin. Matt Parkinson to have a go.
On a length outside off, punched to point.
FOUR! Beautifully flicked away! Full ball on the pads, Shadab Khan flicks it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Good length ball on the pads, Shakeel looks to flick but gets an inside edge, onto the pads and it goes to the leg side. A single taken.
Outside off, punched to covers.
Falls short! Another back of a length ball around middle, Shadab looks to pull but it goes off the top edge towards fine leg where it falls short of the fielder. A single.
FOUR! Nice shot from Shadab Khan! Back of a length ball outside off, Khan rocks on his back foot and then steers it through cover-point for a boundary.
In the channel outside off, Shakeel gets forward and across before pushing it to point. A successful over by Overton.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Back of a length ball on off, Shadab stands back with an open stance and runs it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball on off, it's pushed off the front foot to covers.
A bouncer on middle, to greet the new batsman, Shadab ducks under it.
Shadab Khan is the next man in.

OUT! The blossoming partnership for Pakistan has been nipped in the bud. Sohaib probably got carried away with his attacking instinct. Overton persists with a shortish length delivery, close to off, Maqsood spots the opportunity to once again muscle a horizontal bat shot but this time the bounce gets big on his bat and the ball catches the top edge. The English keeper John Simpson circles around it by moving across to his right and takes the catch safely, well almost safely. End of entertainment from the bat of Maqsood. 162 needed more but only 5 wickets left in the bank for the tourists.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Craig Overton

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball outside off, Shakeel drives it through extra cover for a couple of runs. Good over for Pakistan. 10 runs from it.
FOUR! Brilliant shot from Shakeel! Full on middle, Shakeel flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Miscommunication but safe! Full outside off, Shakeel drives it through the cover region. Shakeel wants three and takes off but Maqsood turns his back on him. Luckily, the throw comes to the wrong end.
Good length ball outside off, Shakeel plays it to cover off the back foot.
On a length on off, Maqsood guides it to third man for one.
Good length ball on middle, Shakeel flicks it to deep square leg for one.

Angles in a length ball on off, Sohaib gets half-forward and pushes it out from the outer half of his bat to cover-point. Some confusion over a run and they decide not to cross eventually. 15 from the over, Pakistan would hope that they build on this excellent over.
Pitches it up and around off, Sohaib bunts it down to mid off. The fielder fumbles slightly but they decide not to risk a run.

SIX! Another biggie in the over although this time Maqsood wasn't in much control. Overton digs in a short delivery on middle and leg, Sohaib top edges his attempted pull shot behind square leg for a maximum.
Good length ball close to off, Maqsood pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Sohaib turns inside the crease and then makes a leave.
Sweetly punched. A length ball is stroked through extra cover. A sliding stop near the fence by the fielder and they take two.

SIX! This one is dismissive from Maqsood. Pakistan would hope that this shot will get them going. Back of a length delivery on middle, Maqsood uses his bottom hand to good effect, clears his front leg and powers it over mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Shakeel punches it wide of third man for a couple.
Good shot and good fielding! Full on middle, Shakeel flicks it in front of square on the leg side. Gregory runs across from deep square leg and makes a good stop. Keeps it down to two.
Short ball outside off, Shakeel plays it to cover off the back foot.
On a length outside off, Saud punches it to cover.
Risky shot but safe! Full around off, Maqsood clears his front leg and then looks to lift it over the off side but it takes the outside edge and goes to third man for one.
Shortish on middle, Maqsood blocks it back to the bowler.
Fullish and just outside off, Shakeel once again is watchful as he draws forward in defense. Maiden, second from Overton!
Make it 5 dot balls now. Overton bowls it on a length outside off, Saud gets across and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
A back foot punch to a length ball to covers. Plenty of dots being played here.
Good length ball around off, angling in, Shakeel stays back to push it towards covers.
Fuller in length again, around off, Shakeel blocks it with a straight bat.
Overton pitches it up and serves it just outside off, Saud shuffles across the stumps to align himself and then blocks it.
Good length ball outside off, Maqsood lifts his bat and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Maqsood lifts it over the cover fielder for a couple.
Full on off, Sohaib pushes it to mid off.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length on off, Maqsood camps back and blocks it out onto the pitch.
Good length ball on middle, Maqsood defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle, Maqsood stays back, uses the angle of the bowler and works it towards square leg for a single. End of a successful over for Craig.
Sohaib Maqsood comes out to bat now.

OUT! Sound of timber! Fakhar Zaman has been put out of his misery. End of a very uncharacteristic knock by Fakhar, it had struggle written all over it. Credit to England to keep the batsman of Zaman's caliber quiet. Overton bowled a delivery that held its line before this one and on this occasion, a length ball lands around off and nips back in off the seam. Fakhar thinks of playing a full-blooded drive but leaves a big gap between his bat and pad. The ball sneaks through to shatter his stumps and somewhat Pakistan's chances in this game. 195 needed off 199 balls.
Beaten all ends up! A length ball around off, holding its line, Zaman tries to push inside the line but misses.
Fuller and close to off, Zaman hangs back with a straight bat in defense.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Shakeel turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Fakhar has decided to have a go after escaping a run out on the last ball. Gives the charge to a length ball and drags his attempted heave over mid-wicket for a run.

A direct hit would have made things interesting! Good length ball on middle, Zaman clips it to the leg side. Shakeel calls him for the single but Zaman is in two minds and then takes off late. Carse reaches the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been close.
Good length ball on off, Zaman defends it out. Zaman is struggling here. He is on 8 off 40 balls.
Full on middle, Zaman pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length on middle, Zaman defends it out.
WIDE! That zipped through! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Zaman looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
Good length ball outside off, Zaman punches it but finds the fielder at covers.
Full on off, Zaman pushes it to mid off. More of a check shot as it goes a bit aerially.
Brydon Carse is into the attack.
On and around off, a length ball is angled in, Saud plays late and pushes it out to point. Another tidy over by Overton.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and jams it down watchfully.
This time the line goes a bit straight, Fakhar moves back and works it through backward square leg for a single. At the moment, this knock from Fakhar is not going anywhere.
Perfect line and length bowling from Overton. Not offering anything. Good length ball close to off, Fakhar shows a straight willow as he blocks.
Brings a full ball into the left-hander, around off, Zaman pushes it gently to point.
A length delivery is served outside off, Fakhar presses forward in defense.
Full on off, Saud pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Nicely tucked away! Efficient shot. Good length ball on middle, Shakeel moves across and then flicks it to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Shakeel looks to flick but misses and gets hit around the box. That must have hurt.
FOUR LEG BYES! Length ball on the pads, Shakeel shuffles across and then looks to flick but it brushes his pads and races to the fine leg fence for four leg byes.
Good length ball outside off, Shakeel shoulders arms to it. Good ball from Mahmood.
Cut away! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel cuts it over the point fielder for two.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now 4 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 38th over.
Shortish around middle and leg, Fakhar fails to work it on the leg side and is struck on the thigh pad. It goes to point. Craig begins with a maiden!

A muted appeal for an lbw! Very full in length and arrowing down the leg side, Fakhar fails to flick and is hit on the pads. Going down leg and Overton is quick to realize that as he pulls out from his lbw shout.
Again a delivery on a length close to off, Zaman is watchful as he presses forward in defense.
This one is on a good length around off, Zaman is on the front foot with a straight bat in defense.
Identical to the last delivery, another back foot punch by Fakhar but he finds the point fielder.
Starts from 'round the wicket with a short ball outside off, Fakhar punches it off his back foot to point.
Change in bowling. Craig Overton to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery to end the over! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Another brilliant over from Mahmood.
Good length ball on middle, Shakeel flicks it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
BEATEN! Beaut from Mahmood! Good length ball outside off, Shakeel looks to defend but misses.
Saud Shakeel comes out to bat, replacing Mohammad Rizwan.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a ball from Saqib Mahmood! He is making a case for his selection into the regular ODI squad for England here and Pakistan sink further. Good length ball outside off, Rizwan looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes towards Simpson, the keeper and he makes no mistake. 212 needed in 231 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Saqib Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball on off, Zaman guides it to third man for one.
On a length on middle, Zaman pushes it to mid on.

Just short! Fakhar Zaman is living dangerously here! Good length ball outside off, Zaman looks to swing it away but gets a top edge and it flies to third man. Mahmood comes charging ahead but it falls short. A single taken.
Length ball on off, Fakhar plays it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Rizwan heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, Zaman works it wide of mid on for one. No Ball given and a Free Hit will follow.
Good length ball around off, Zaman looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full on off, pushed to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Zaman cuts it to point.
Good length ball outside off, Rizwan lets it go to the keeper.
Full on off, Rizwan looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the leg side.
BEATEN! This is superb bowling! Full around off, Rizwan looks to drive but the ball swings in and beats the inside edge.
Good length ball outside off, Zaman looks to drive but gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
Full on middle, Zaman pushes it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball outside off, Zaman lets it go to the keeper.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Nicely driven! Full on middle, Rizwan drives it through mid on for a boundary. Rizwan is off the mark in style.
Good length ball outside off, Rizwan shoulders arms to it.
On middle, nudged to the leg side.
Full on off, Rizwan walks across his stumps and defends it out.
Good length ball on middle, Zaman pushes it to mid on for one.
BEATEN! Superb, just superb. Good length ball outside off, Rizwan hangs on the back foot and looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Mohammad Rizwan is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! All reds it is and Babar Azam goes, taking a review with himself. It is once again Mahmood who gets rid of Babar Azam. Length ball around middle, Azam looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Saqib Mahmood and company appeal and the finger has gone up. Azam has taken the review after Zaman convinces him to. The Ultra Edge shows nothing while the Ball Tracker shows all reds. Pakistan in trouble early on.
Babar Azam has been given out LBW! He has taken the review. The Ultra Edge shows nothing while the Ball Tracker shows all reds and Babar Azam has to go.
Fullish ball on middle, Zaman works it wide of mid on for one.
Unplayable delivery from Mahmood! Good length ball outside off, Mahmood looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge and it goes to the keeper.
On a length on off, Zaman defends it to the off side. Zaman says yes for the single at first but then sees the fielder coming to the ball quickly and sends Azam back.
Back of a length ball on middle, Zaman works it to mid-wicket.
Fullish ball on off, Azam defends it to cover.
FOUR! This is the best of Babar Azam! Full on middle, Azam drives it through the mid on region for a boundary.
Fullish ball outside off, Azam lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! Azam makes full use of the Free Hit! Good length ball on middle, Azam lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
NO BALL AND FOUR! This is very good timing from Azam! Good length ball on the pads, Azam flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Free Hit will follow.
Full on off, Fakhar pushes it to mid off for one.
Full on off, Zaman dances down the track and thrashes it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Babar defends it to point.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Good length ball around off, Azam looks to drive but it beats the inside edge and goes to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Azam looks to cut but it goes off the bottom half to the slip cordon.
FOUR! Loose from Mahmood and Azam will not miss out on these! Full ball outside off, Azam drives it through cover for a boundary.
WIDE! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Azam looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Good length ball outside off, Babar lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Azam punches it back to the bowler.
Full on off, Zaman plays it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Zaman nudges it to square leg.
Full on off, Azam drives it to mid off where the fielder misfields and that allows the batters to take three.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Azam lets it go. Wided.
BEATEN! That ball swung like a banana! Good length ball on off, it moves away a lot after pitching. Azam looks to defend but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Azam lets it go to the keeper.
Babar Azam is the next man in. Can he take Pakistan home here?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent start from Lewis Grgory and Imam-ul-Haq's poor form continues. Gregory is having a good game here. Length ball around off, it moves away. Ul-Haq looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes to the left of the keeper. Simpson moves to that side and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Lewis Gregory

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? Lewis Gregory it is.
BEATEN! Excellent over from Saqib Mahmood! Good length ball around off, Zaman looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge and it goes to the keeper.
On a length on the pads, Fakhar looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad again.
Full on the pads, Zaman looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Full on middle, Fakhar pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Zaman looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Mahmood starts with a length ball on middle, Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket for a single.
